extension.explanation: SPI-3 has fallen to -1.18, below the Alert threshold of -1.0. VCI is at 32% (Alert < 35%) and dekadal rainfall is only 48% of normal. This means the last three months were drier than usual and vegetation is already stressed in rainfed pockets of Turkana Central and Loima. Confidence is moderate-high (78%) based on converging rainfall and vegetation signals.

actions.title: Advise selective destocking of weak stock
actions.why: SPI-3 Alert and falling VCI signal pasture will not recover soon.
actions.resources: County livestock markets; Kenya Meat Commission contacts; community baraza slots

actions.title: Map household water points still yielding
actions.why: Rainfall at 48% of normal — shallow wells may fail first.
actions.resources: Ward water user committees; hand-pump spare parts list

actions.title: Promote drought-tolerant fodder / crop advice
actions.why: Soil and vegetation stress already at Alert — reduce high-water crops.
actions.resources: KEPHIS seed list; extension demo plots; radio spots (HUSIKA-style)

extension.sms: ANZA ALERT Turkana Central/Loima: SPI-3=-1.18 (Alert). Act: 1) selective destock weak animals 2) check yielding water points 3) switch to drought-tolerant fodder. Valid to 5 Aug. Source: ICPAC-style thresholds (demo).

drm.explanation: Multiple drought indicators crossed Alert in Turkana Central & Loima. SPI-3 (-1.18), VCI (32%), and dekadal rainfall (48% of normal) jointly justify activating low-cost anticipatory measures now — before Alarm. This is not an emergency declaration; it is a window to reduce response cost.

actions.title: Activate ward AA checklist (Alert tier)
actions.why: Threshold Alert requires pre-agreed actions, not wait-and-see.
actions.resources: County Contingency Plan Alert annex; DRM WhatsApp group

actions.title: Pre-position water trucking request forms
actions.why: Rainfall deficit often precedes borehole congestion in 2–3 weeks.
actions.resources: NDMA / county water dept request templates

actions.title: Brief chiefs on Alert messaging (EN/SW)
actions.why: Clear community messaging reduces panic and rumour.
actions.resources: HUSIKA-style SMS scripts; chief baraza schedule

drm.sms: ANZA DRM ALERT Turkana C/Loima: drought Alert (SPI-3=-1.18, VCI=32%). Do: activate AA checklist, prep water trucking forms, brief chiefs EN/SW. Valid to 5 Aug. Demo fixtures ICPAC-style.

extension.explanation: Kakuma–Kalobeyei corridor is at Alarm: SPI-3=-1.62 (Alarm ≤ -1.5), VCI=22% (Alarm ≤ 25%), soil moisture anomaly=-38% (Alarm ≤ -35%), rainfall=31% of normal. Pasture regeneration before the next rains is unlikely. Livestock body condition will deteriorate quickly without feed/water support.

actions.title: Prioritize emergency livestock feed targeting
actions.why: VCI and soil moisture at Alarm — natural pasture insufficient.
actions.resources: County feed stores; FAO/partner feed pipelines; beneficiary lists

actions.title: Guide herds to remaining dry-season grazing reserves
actions.why: SPI-3 Alarm indicates multi-month rainfall failure.
actions.resources: Traditional grazing agreements; conflict-sensitive corridor maps

actions.title: Scale animal health outreach (parasites, disease)
actions.why: Stressed animals are more disease-prone during Alarm.
actions.resources: County vet teams; community disease reporters

extension.sms: ANZA ALARM Kakuma-Kalobeyei: SPI-3=-1.62 VCI=22% soil=-38%. Act NOW: emergency feed targeting, move herds to dry-season reserves, scale animal health. Valid to 12 Aug.

drm.explanation: Four indicators converge at Alarm for Kakuma–Kalobeyei. Confidence 86%. This justifies escalating from Alert AA to Alarm-tier anticipatory action: water trucking surge, hotspot monitoring near settlements/refugee-host interface, and coordination with NDMA/partners.

actions.title: Trigger Alarm-tier water trucking surge
actions.why: Rainfall 31% of normal + soil moisture Alarm → borehole queues likely.
actions.resources: County water trucks; partner tanker roster; fuel contingency

actions.title: Stand up daily drought ops cell
actions.why: Multi-indicator Alarm needs daily situation updates.
actions.resources: DRM ops room; NDMA liaison; HUSIKA broadcast slots

actions.title: Map conflict-sensitive water/grazing hotspots
actions.why: Alarm drought often increases resource competition.
actions.resources: Ward admins; peace committees; police liaison

drm.sms: ANZA DRM ALARM Kakuma-Kalobeyei: 4 indicators Alarm. Trigger water trucking surge, daily ops cell, map water/grazing hotspots. Valid to 12 Aug. Demo ICPAC-style.

extension.explanation: Turkana South is approaching Alert: SPI-3=-0.82 (Alert at -1.0), VCI=38% (still above 35%), rainfall=68% of normal (Alert at 60%). This is a preparedness window — cheap actions now beat costly response later.

actions.title: Refresh farmer/pastoralist contact trees
actions.why: Watch stage — ensure you can reach households if Alert trips.
actions.resources: WhatsApp groups; chief lists; radio call-in

actions.title: Check seed/fodder stock readiness
actions.why: If SPI-3 crosses -1.0, distribution must be fast.
actions.resources: Extension stores; cooperative inventories

actions.title: Run one preparedness baraza on water rationing
actions.why: Community habits set early reduce later conflict.
actions.resources: Ward offices; water user associations

extension.sms: ANZA WATCH Turkana South: SPI-3=-0.82 nearing Alert. Prep: refresh contacts, check fodder/seed stocks, hold water rationing baraza. Monitor to 8 Aug.

drm.explanation: Watch means indicators are deteriorating toward Alert but have not crossed. Use this window to verify contingency stocks, confirm AA financing triggers, and rehearse SMS trees — low cost, high readiness.

actions.title: Verify Alert AA financing / authority chain
actions.why: Avoid delay when SPI-3 crosses -1.0.
actions.resources: County contingency fund SOPs; CECM sign-off list

actions.title: Test SMS tree to ward admins
actions.why: Watch → Alert transition must be communicable in hours.
actions.resources: HUSIKA-style channel; DRM WhatsApp

actions.title: Audit water truck readiness (fuel, drivers)
actions.why: If Alert hits, trucking request latency dominates impact.
actions.resources: County fleet log; partner tanker MoUs

drm.sms: ANZA DRM WATCH Turkana South: nearing Alert (SPI-3=-0.82). Verify AA finance chain, test SMS tree, audit water trucks. Monitor to 8 Aug.

extension.explanation: Lodwar peri-urban indicators improved: SPI-3=-0.55 and VCI=42%, both better than Alert. Localized rains helped, but do not fully stand down — residual stress and false recovery are common. Continue advisory monitoring.

actions.title: Shift messaging from crisis to recovery advice
actions.why: Indicators above Alert — avoid alarm fatigue.
actions.resources: Radio spots; baraza scripts

actions.title: Assess which herds still need supplementary feed
actions.why: Recovery is uneven across households.
actions.resources: Extension field visits; community animal health workers

actions.title: Document lessons for next Alert cycle
actions.why: Improves next anticipatory action round.
actions.resources: Simple after-action template

extension.sms: ANZA RECOVERING Lodwar: SPI-3=-0.55 VCI=42% above Alert. Continue light monitoring, target residual feed needs, capture lessons. Valid to 31 Jul.

drm.explanation: Post-Alert recovery in Lodwar peri-urban. SPI-3 and VCI no longer breach Alert, but county should keep a reduced ops tempo and confirm stocks are replenished before the next dry spell.

actions.title: Scale down daily ops to weekly sitrep
actions.why: Indicators recovered above Alert — save staff time.
actions.resources: DRM ops calendar

actions.title: Replenish contingency stocks used in Alert
actions.why: Next Watch/Alert may arrive before full recovery region-wide.
actions.resources: Procurement / partner pipelines

actions.title: Publish all-clear with monitoring caveat
actions.why: Communities need clarity without false security.
actions.resources: HUSIKA-style SMS; chief network

drm.sms: ANZA DRM RECOVERING Lodwar: indicators above Alert. Weekly sitrep OK, replenish stocks, issue all-clear with monitoring caveat. Valid to 31 Jul.
